context: Daichi and Mei look at a new housing development.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: housing chat; construction vocabulary (住宅/建設/土地/メーカー/ドア) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: この辺、新しい住宅が建設中やな。
lines.en: Around here, new housing is under construction.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 広い土地ですね。誰が建てるんですか?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 大手の住宅メーカーが、建設しとるんよ。
lines.en: A major housing maker is constructing it.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm informative delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メーカーによって、ドアの形も違いますね。
lines.en: Doors differ in shape by maker.
lines.style: observant woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そや、ドアや窓に、こだわりが出るんよ。
lines.en: Right, makers show their flair in doors and windows.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: この土地は、日当たりが良さそうです。
lines.en: This land seems to get good sunlight.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 住宅の建設には、ええ土地やね。
lines.en: It's good land for building housing.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm friendly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 完成した住宅、見てみたいですね。
lines.en: I'd like to see the finished houses.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm closing delivery throughout
